title: Главная
text:
What is Cashback+? Do I need to pay for using Cashback+? No. Using Cashback+ is completely free for customers. How does Cashback+ work? 1. You find an interesting product.
2. We show offers from different sellers.
3. You compare the price, discounts and possible cashback.
4. You choose the best option.
5. You connect bonuses.
6. You go to the seller What makes Cashback+ different? Why can prices differ from prices on the seller Prices and discounts are updated regularly, but sellers can change them at any time. The final price is always displayed on the seller When will I get cashback? After the seller confirms the purchase. The timeframe depends on the store and can range from several days to 3 months. Do I need to create an account? Registration is not required to view products. To receive cashback, bonuses, track orders and access your personal account, you will need to create an account. What percentage of Cashback+ rewards goes to you and what remains with the company? From the cashback received and optional ads viewed, you get 80%, and from the commission received by Cashback+ for attracting a participant to various research programs - 50% in the form of bonuses. Rewards from passive advertising placed on the site remain fully on the site How can I use bonuses? Who does Cashback+ work with? What are the conditions for participating in research programs? Why does Cashback+ carry out transfers through an intermediary? Due to increasing hacker attacks on websites to steal personal banking data, Cashback+ refused to collect and store them. All transfers are entrusted to an intermediary that professionally ensures their comprehensive security. Cashback+ covers the cost of the intermediary Will bonuses be returned if the purchase did not go through? Can I return an item? Yes. Returns are handled according to the rules of the store where the purchase was made. If an order is cancelled or an item is returned, the seller usually cancels the cashback accrual as well. Can I use Cashback+ on my mobile phone? Yes, the service works on computers, tablets and smartphones. What should I do if cashback doesn Contact support through your personal account. We will check the status of the transition and purchase and try to help. How to contact Cashback+? Since all Cashback+ employees work remotely and office space is not used, you won Что такое Cashback+? Нужно ли платить за использование Cashback+? Нет. Использование Cashback+ полностью бесплатно для покупателей. Как работает Cashback+? 1. Вы находите интересующий товар.
2. Мы показываем предложения от разных продавцов.
3. Вы сравниваете цену, скидки и возможный кешбэк.
4. Выбираете лучший вариант.
5. Подключаете бонусы.
6. Переходите на сайт продавца и оформляете заказ. Чем отличается Cashback+ от других? Почему цены могут отличаться от цен на сайте продавца? Цены и скидки обновляются регулярно, но продавцы могут изменить их в любой момент. Окончательная цена всегда отображается на сайте продавца перед оформлением заказа. Когда я получу кешбэк? После подтверждения покупки продавцом. Срок зависит от магазина и может составлять от нескольких дней до 3 месяцев. Нужно ли создавать аккаунт? Для просмотра товаров регистрация не обязательна. Для получения кешбэка, бонусов, отслеживания заказов и доступа к личному кабинету потребуется создать аккаунт. Какие проценты от вознаграждения Cashback+ переводятся вам и какие остаются у компании? Как можно использовать бонусы? С кем работает Cashback+? Какие условия участия в исследовательских программах? Почему Cashback+ осуществляет переводы через посредника? Вернутся ли бонусы, если покупка не состоялась? Можно ли вернуть товар? Да. Возврат товара осуществляется по правилам магазина, в котором была совершена покупка. Если заказ отменён или товар возвращён, продавец обычно отменяет и начисление кешбэка. Можно ли пользоваться Cashback+ с мобильного телефона? Да, сервис работает на компьютерах, планшетах и смартфонах. Что делать, если кешбэк не появился? Свяжитесь со службой поддержки через личный кабинет. Мы проверим статус перехода и покупки и постараемся помочь. Как связаться с Cashback+? Поскольку все сотрудники Cashback+ работают удаленно офисное помещение не используется, вы не сможете посетить нас лично. Для связи используйте информацию, размещённую на странице «Контакты». Smart shopping with Cashback+ Get cashback from stores, bonuses for watching ads and participating in research. Combine them and compensate up to 100% of your purchases. Умные покупки с Cashback+ Получайте кэшбэк, бонусы за просмотр рекламы и участие в исследованиях. Комбинируйте их и компенсируйте до 100% своих покупок. Smartes Einkaufen mit Cashback+ Erhalten Sie Cashback von Geschäften, Boni für das Ansehen von Werbung und die Teilnahme an Umfragen. Kombinieren Sie sie und kompensieren Sie bis zu 100% Ihrer Einkäufe. title: Условия использования
text: Cashback+ Terms and Conditions Effective date: 30 September 2026 Jurisdiction: United Kingdom Cashback+ is a UK-based rewards platform operated by Cashback Plus Ltd. We provide users with cashback from retailers, bonuses for viewing advertising videos, and bonuses for participation in research programmes. Our service allows users to reduce the cost of purchases made through Cashback+ by combining cashback and bonuses, including compensation up to 100% of the purchase value. Cashback+ provides three types of rewards: cashback from retailers, video bonuses, and research bonuses. Each reward type has its own rules and is credited differently. 3.1. Retailer Commission and Cashback When a user makes a purchase through Cashback+, the retailer pays Cashback+ a commission for referring the customer. Cashback+ transfers a defined percentage of this commission to the user as cashback. The cashback percentage varies depending on the retailer and is displayed to the user before the purchase is made. 3.2. Bonuses for Viewing Advertising Videos Users may voluntarily view advertising video materials. Cashback+ credits bonuses as a share of the advertising commission received. These bonuses: are a share of commission that Cashback+ distributes to the user; are credited to the user’s bonus balance; are not electronic money or a financial instrument; cannot be withdrawn directly; may only be used to compensate the cost of purchases on Cashback+; have a fixed value: 1 bonus = £1 when compensating a purchase. Before viewing a video, the user sees the exact number of bonuses that will be credited. 3.3. Bonuses for Participation in Research Programmes Research companies may pay Cashback+ a commission for attracting users to participate in surveys, interviews, or product testing. Cashback+ transfers a percentage of this commission to the user in the form of bonuses. These bonuses: are a share of the commission distributed by Cashback+; are credited to the user’s bonus balance; cannot be withdrawn directly; may only be used to compensate purchases; are shown to the user before participation. 3.3.1. Direct Payments from Research Companies Some research companies may pay users directly for participation (e.g. £20 for an interview). These payments: are made directly to the user; do not pass through Cashback+; are not reflected in the Cashback+ balance; do not participate in any calculations between Cashback+ and the user. 3.4. Transfer of Bonuses Between Users Users may transfer bonuses to other registered Cashback+ users, including forum participants. Transferred bonuses retain their purpose and may only be used by the recipient to compensate purchases. 4.1. Bonus Monetisation Bonuses may only be monetised when making a purchase through Cashback+. Monetisation automatically reduces the cost of the product by the bonus amount. If the combined value of cashback and bonuses equals the product price, the user receives up to 100% compensation. 4.2. Payout of Cashback and Monetised Bonuses Confirmed cashback and monetised bonuses may be paid out to the user immediately after automatic confirmation. Payouts are made as a single combined payment without partial withdrawal options. 4.3. No Storage of Funds Cashback+ does not store user funds. We do not accumulate balances, hold money, or allow funds to be used for future purchases. All payments are processed automatically and immediately after confirmation. Bonuses are not electronic money or a financial instrument. Bonuses cannot be exchanged for cash or used outside Cashback+. Cashback is credited only when purchases are tracked correctly. Bonuses are credited only when confirmed by advertisers or research companies. Direct payments from research companies do not pass through Cashback+. Cashback+ may adjust balances in case of errors, returns, or misuse. Users must act honestly, provide accurate information, and refrain from creating duplicate accounts. Abusive behaviour, fraud, or attempts to manipulate the system may result in account suspension or closure. These Terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales. Any disputes shall be resolved by the courts of England and Wales. 1. Who We Are 2. How Cashback+ Works 3. Source of Cashback and Bonuses 4. Monetisation of Bonuses and Payouts 5. Legal Restrictions and Clarifications 6. Behaviour and Account Rules 7. Legal Jurisdiction
